marks.name: title
marks.text: Hi, and welcome to the first post on this blog.

marks.name: lede
marks.text: This page is running on a shared engine — the same one that powers the presidocs blog — but all of its content lives in a completely separate repository.

marks.name: how-body
marks.text: The engine is a file dependency. The player you're listening to, the commenting system, and the build pipeline all come from it. This repo only holds posts, figures, and a little configuration.

marks.name: figure
marks.text: Watch the dot to the side — it's a figure defined right here in this repo, pulsing in time with the narration to prove that custom, content-owned animations work across the engine boundary.

marks.name: closing
marks.text: That's the whole idea: write content here, let the engine do the rest. Thanks for listening!
